reviews.review_description:
Dendrite Bloom is a gentle, cozy mixed-reality experience that turns paper folding into a beautiful brain-teasing puzzle. Nestled in a neural garden, the game uses hand tracking to let you fold paper and anticipate where the next hole will appear. 🌿✨

With 20 progressive levels and 200 carefully designed exercises, there's plenty to explore. Start with simple folds, then gradually tackle short folds, diagonals, and layered patterns. Each challenge encourages you to think ahead, work backwards from a target, discover how light passes through every layer, or follow ink through the top layers.

As you progress, the puzzles become more challenging, even asking you to visualise folds entirely in your head! The final designer challenges give you the freedom to choose your own creases to recreate the target pattern.

I love the combination of thoughtful puzzles, natural hand interactions, and a calm mixed-reality setting. Dendrite Bloom offers a relaxing way to exercise your spatial reasoning and creativity at your own pace. A lovely experience for anyone who enjoys clever puzzles with a peaceful, immersive atmosphere! 🧠🌷
